description: Steps through the channels of a polyphonic cable one at a time, turning it into a monophonic sequence

params.text: Alt mode: the output becomes the average of the current channel and the next one, a fixed blend of the two rather than a slide between them

inputs.text: The channels to be played, one channel per step of the sequence
A rising edge above 2V advances one step
A rising edge above 2V returns the sequence to its first channel, at once if the clock input is above 0.1V and otherwise on the next clock edge; the maker's tooltip states this the other way round
Sets how many channels are played before the sequence wraps, the first channel alone at 0V and all of them at 10V

outputs.text: The channel the sequence has reached

notes: the drawing above the jacks plots each input channel as a dot placed by its voltage, from -10V at the left to +10V at the right, with a line across the channel being played.

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V on a single step.
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
